items.title: Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) Review: Best-Sounding Clip-On, But Pricey
items.summary: CNET rates the second-generation Ultra Open Earbuds 8.2/10, praising new drivers with deeper bass, longer 9-hour battery and improved call clarity, while flagging the $299 price as $100 above rivals. It earns an Editors' Choice as the best clip-on open earbuds on the market.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: Small, Smart, and Finally Fitting Properly
items.summary: The Review Bench finds the WF-1000XM6 deliver class-leading transparency and ANC within a few dB of category leaders, with a redesigned shell about 12% smaller in volume that finally fixes fit complaints. LC3 over LE Audio and Auracast reception are confirmed via firmware update.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open Open Pre-Booking Live Ahead of October 23 India Launch
items.summary: Indian brand Noise opened pre-bookings for its first Sound by Bose clip-on earbuds at Rs 999, with a full launch at Rs 7,999. The C-bridge open-ear TWS pairs a 10.8mm driver and Dynamic EQ co-developed with Bose, 4-mic ENC and up to 28 hours of playback.

items.title: Samsung's First Clip-On Galaxy Buds On Keep You Aware of the World
items.summary: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on open-ear earbuds launching in Korea on October 27 for KRW 299,000. They use 11.3mm TwinBoost speakers, Audio Leakage Reduction, three mics plus a bone-conduction sensor, Gemini Live and head-gesture controls, with up to 9.5 hours of battery.

items.title: JBL Expands Endurance Line With Five New Performance Earbuds Models
items.summary: HARMAN announced five new JBL Endurance earbuds built for sports and peak performance, extending the workout-focused true-wireless range. The lineup targets durable, sweat-resistant designs with long battery life for active users.

items.title: Omdia: Apple Grew Earbud Shipments to 16.8M in Q2 as TWS Market Shrank 0.7%
items.summary: Omdia's Q2 2026 data shows global TWS shipments fell 0.7% to 82.1 million units, the first year-over-year drop since Q2 2023, while Apple held 20.5% share. Open-wireless stereo (OWS) grew 12% to 11.1 million and is forecast to reach 90.5 million by 2030, with clip-on designs leading.

items.title: Galaxy Buds On vs Sony LinkBuds Clip: Samsung Has Some Catching Up to Do
items.summary: Gadget Flow compares Samsung's new clip-on Buds On against the Sony LinkBuds Clip, noting Samsung's stronger Galaxy-AI ecosystem with hands-free Gemini Live and head gestures but iPhone incompatibility. Battery is a near draw at 9.5 vs 9 hours per charge.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Aggregated Rating: 4.3 Across Six Published Reviews
items.summary: Verdict Reviews averages six published ratings of the WF-1000XM6 at 4.3, highlighting the new QN3e processor, eight-microphone array and significantly improved ANC versus the XM5. The $329.99 price and unchanged battery life are flagged as the main sticking points.

items.title: Bose Advances Open-Ear Audio With Sport Open and Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen)
items.summary: Bose unveiled the Sport Open and Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) on September 17, expanding its open-ear range with Bluetooth 5.4, multipoint, improved drivers and up to 9 hours of battery. The Ultra Open (2nd Gen) adds Cinema Mode with TrueSpatial and ships October 1 from $299.

items.title: Bose Launches New Open-Ear Earbuds for Athletes With Longer Battery Life
items.summary: News Minimalist reports Bose's two new open-ear models for athletes and daily use bring improved battery life and call clarity, launching in October 2026. The Sport Open offers 7 hours of playback and IP54 resistance, while the Ultra 2nd Gen delivers 9 hours plus a new Cinema mode.
